payload.claim: The new extraction schema types `_SpecReviewFinding.criterion` as `int | None` (line 76), but the pre-existing `SpecReviewFinding.criterion` that `read_spec_review` populates from the same fenced JSON block is typed `str | None` (line 121), and its own fixtures in `tests/test_spec_review.py` (e.g. `"criterion": "1"` at lines 153 and 337) assume a string. Because `_findings_text` serializes the validated model straight through `model_dump(mode="json")` (line 283), every review produced through this new pipeline will now write `criterion` as a JSON integer into the fenced block, which `read_spec_review`'s untyped `raw.get("criterion")` (line 225) passes straight into `SpecReviewFinding`, silently retyping a field the rest of the module still declares and tests as a string.
